description: This source file implements a placement filter director for Orleans that filters silos based on matching specified metadata keys, ensuring placement decisions consider silo metadata consistency.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: Class responsible for filtering silos based on required metadata matching during silo placement decisions.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a list of silo addresses based on metadata matching strategy and target specifications.

methods.name: DoesMetadataMatch
methods.description: Determines if the local metadata matches remote silo metadata for the specified keys.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata values for specified keys from a silo metadata object.
